about: Curated, age-appropriate, size-limited Kaggle datasets for student research projects.

datasets.title: Students Performance in Exams
datasets.description: Marks secured by high school students in math, reading, and writing alongside study habits, test preparation courses, and demographic background.
sample_questions: How does completing a test preparation course correlate with math vs reading performance?
Is there a correlation between parental education level and student performance across subjects?
limitations: Sample size of 1,000 students from a single simulated group; results may not generalize.
Suggestion only: Correlation does not imply causation between background factors and exam scores.
Lacks longitudinal tracking across multiple academic terms.

datasets.title: Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset
datasets.description: Sleep duration, sleep quality, physical activity levels, stress levels, and cardiovascular indicators across diverse routines and occupations.
sample_questions: What is the correlation between daily physical activity and reported sleep quality?
Does higher daily stress correlate with shorter sleep duration or disrupted sleep patterns?
limitations: Dataset is synthetic and modeled based on adult lifestyle surveys.
Suggestion only: Observed associations between sleep and stress do not prove a causal direction.
Adult occupations may not directly match middle/high school student schedules.

datasets.title: Water Potability and Quality Metrics
datasets.description: Water quality metrics including pH, hardness, solids (TDS), chloramines, sulfate, conductivity, organic carbon, and turbidity.
sample_questions: How does water pH correlate with sulfate levels across sampled bodies of water?
Which chemical metrics show the highest variation between potable and non-potable samples?
limitations: Missing values exist in several chemical measurement columns (e.g. sulfate, pH).
Suggestion only: Water potability is multifaceted; single chemical thresholds do not guarantee safety.
Samples are from diverse unnamed water bodies without geographical coordinates.

datasets.title: Global Weather and Climate Observations
datasets.description: Daily weather indicators across major world cities including temperature, humidity, wind speed, pressure, and air quality index.
sample_questions: How does humidity correlate with temperature across equatorial vs temperate cities?
What is the relationship between wind speed and air pressure drops?
limitations: Observations represent major metropolitan weather stations with potential urban heat island effects.
Suggestion only: Short-term weather correlations do not demonstrate long-term climate trends.
Air quality measurements use standard sensors that may vary across station providers.

datasets.title: Household Electric Power Consumption
datasets.description: Measurements of electric power consumption in a household with a one-minute sampling rate, tracking voltage, global active power, and sub-metering.
datasets.attribution_text: Georges Hebrail, Alice Berard. Electric power consumption dataset, UCI Machine Learning Repository / Kaggle.
sample_questions: At what hours of the day does household power consumption reach peak intensity?
How does sub-metering for kitchen appliances compare to climate control energy use?
limitations: Data collected from a single household in France; patterns reflect specific regional habits.
Suggestion only: High usage intervals suggest usage spikes but do not detail individual appliance efficiency.
Sub-metering values are grouped rather than itemized per individual outlet.

datasets.title: Crop Yield and Weather Factors
datasets.description: Annual agricultural yields for major crops across various countries, matched with average temperature, rainfall, and pesticide usage.
sample_questions: How does average rainfall correlate with maize yield across different climate zones?
Is there an observable relationship between average temperature trends and wheat productivity?
limitations: National aggregate figures obscure regional soil quality and local irrigation infrastructure.
Suggestion only: Yield variations reflect complex socio-economic and technological inputs beyond rainfall.
Pesticide records are country-level averages rather than farm-specific applications.

datasets.title: Roller Coaster Physics and Mechanics
datasets.description: Specifications of roller coasters worldwide including speed, height, drop, length, inversions, and material type (steel vs wood).
sample_questions: How closely does maximum speed correlate with total drop height according to gravitational potential energy models?
Do steel roller coasters exhibit significantly higher inversion counts than wooden roller coasters?
limitations: Historical entries may have missing speed or drop records.
Suggestion only: Theoretical physics models (v = sqrt(2gh)) assume zero friction, which real tracks possess.
Some coaster types use launch mechanisms rather than gravity-driven drops.

datasets.title: Chess Game Mechanics and Openings
datasets.description: Over 20,000 rated games from Lichess, recording turns, victory status, winner, opening moves, opening code, and player ratings.
sample_questions: Which opening moves have the highest white win rate among beginner vs intermediate players?
How does player rating difference correlate with game length in turns?
limitations: Data is collected exclusively from online blitz/rapid games on Lichess.
Suggestion only: Opening move win rates do not determine individual match outcomes.
Rating disparities in casual games may skew move quality statistics.
